definitions.content: Report issued by a test laboratory that includes the results of tests and examinations it carried out on the basis of the relevant OIML Recommendation during OIML type evaluation on identified sample(s) of a given type of measuring instrument or module

notes.content: Unless the OIML Recommendation states otherwise, several test reports may be issued if several test laboratories are involved in covering all of the tests and examinations specified in the relevant OIML Recommendation.
